Overview

To receive your funds in time to pay your semester tuition and fees, you must be registered for classes and meet all disbursement requirements. Track the status of your funds in your FAST portal. Estimated disbursement dates for various types of financial aid are included below. Dates for the current semester can be found on the Office of Academic Records and Registrar website.
Back to Top
2026-2027 Academic Year
June 2026
Apply for your 2026-2027 Direct Loan and/or Graduate PLUS Loan , if eligible.
Mid-July 2026
Fall 2026 charges and USC scholarships and grants begin posting to student billing accounts.
For more information: USC Payment Plan .
August 14, 2026
Federal and state financial aid and/or loan funds begin posting to student billing accounts. You must meet all disbursement requirements and be registered for the fall 2026 semester.
For more information: Direct Loan and Direct Grad PLUS Loan
August 19, 2026
Direct deposit of fall 2026 financial aid refunds begins for those whose financial aid exceeds their semester charges. Sign up for direct deposit .
August 21, 2026

Fall 2026 payment deadline. Your student billing account must be paid in full to avoid late fees and finance charges. Track your account status by logging in to Experience USC or myUSC and selecting “USCe.pay/Current Billing Balance.”
Federal Work-Study Job Fair
Visit the Career Center website for more information.
August 24, 2026
First day of fall 2026 semester classes.
September 11, 2026
Last day for most students to add courses or drop courses with eligibility for a refund. To verify your add and drop deadlines, visit the Academic Calendar .
Last day to opt out of tuition refund insurance and to waive student health insurance.
October 1, 2026
FAFSA available for 2027-28 academic year. Check back for specific dates.
December 2026
Spring 2027 charges and USC scholarships begin posting to student billing accounts. You must meet all disbursement requirements and be registered for the spring 2027 semester.
For more information: USC Payment Plan .
January 1, 2027
Federal and state financial aid and/or loans funds begin posting to student billing accounts. You must meet all disbursement requirements and be registered for the spring 2027 semester.
For more information: Direct Loan and Direct Grad PLUS Loan .
January 6, 2027
Direct deposit of spring 2027 financial aid refunds begins for those whose financial aid exceeds their semester charges. Sign up for direct deposit .
January 8, 2027

Spring 2027 payment deadline. Your student billing account must be paid in full to avoid late fees and finance charges. Track the status of your account by logging in to Experience USC or myUSC and selecting “USCe.pay/Current Billing Balance.”
January 11, 2027
First day of spring 2027 semester classes.
January 29, 2027
Last day for most students to add courses or drop courses with eligibility for a refund. To verify your add and drop deadlines, visit the Academic Calendar .
Last day to opt out of tuition refund insurance and to waive student health insurance.
Financial aid application deadline for graduate students.
